thesis: Both disclosed trades are stale by the time they are visible: one filed with a roughly 30-day disclosure lag on a trade made about two months ago, the other similarly lagged. One buy and one sell from members without a clearly relevant committee assignment beyond general financial oversight. The pending legislation is still in committee with no scheduled vote. None of this rises above noise for a directional call.

key_evidence.claim: House member buy, ~30d disclosure lag, trade itself ~55d old
Export-control amendment still in committee, no floor vote scheduled

what_would_change_my_mind: A committee vote being scheduled on the export-control amendment, or a cluster of same-direction trades from members on a directly relevant committee.
